title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for False Ventricular Tachycardia Alarm Reduction in the ICU
abstract: arXiv:2609.08992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: False ventricular tachycardia (VT) alarms are a leading contributor to alarm fatigue in intensive care units. We propose a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with ICU-realistic data augmentations and a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the three-element Windkessel hemodynamic model, implemented as a differentiable forward simulation. By requiring the network's latent representation to produce physiologically plausible arterial pressure waveforms, artifact-driven ECG patterns are penalized while true VT remains coherent across modalities. Evaluated on the VTaC benchmark under a strict real-time protocol (10-second pre-alarm window), our method achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement over prior state-of-the-art. translated_title: 物理信息驱动的深度学习用于减少ICU中的假性室性心动过速警报
translated_abstract: 假性室性心动过速（VT）警报是导致重症监护病房（ICU）警报疲劳的主要原因之一。我们提出了一种深度学习框架，该框架将一维SE-ResNet与符合ICU实际情况的数据增强相结合，并引入一项基于三元素Windkessel血流动力学模型的物理信息辅助重建任务，该任务以可微分前向仿真的方式实现。通过要求网络的潜在表示生成符合生理规律的动脉血压波形，由伪迹驱动的ECG模式会受到惩罚，而真正的VT在各模态间保持一致性。在严格的实时协议（警报前10秒窗口）下，在VTaC基准数据集上进行评估，我们的方法相比之前的最先进方法在挑战赛得分上提升了5分。消融研究证实，物理信息目标是性能提升的主要驱动力，它带来了准确率的提升、2倍的标签效率，以及更具局部性和临床意义的（可解释性）。
tldr: 该论文提出将一维SE-ResNet与基于Windkessel血流动力学模型的物理信息辅助重建任务相结合的深度学习框架，通过惩罚生理上不可信的伪迹模式，在VTaC基准上实现了假性室速警报抑制性能的5分提升，并带来2倍的标签效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the Windkessel hemodynamic model, which penalizes physiologically implausible artifact patterns and achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement in reducing false ventricular tachycardia alarms on the VTaC benchmark, along with 2x label efficiency.
